mapper.select: SELECT instrument_id, ticker, tradable FROM instruments WHERE ticker = #{ticker}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, portfolio_id, instrument_id, side, quantity, price, status, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{portfolioId}, #{instrumentId}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT #{externalOrderId} AS orderId, o.status AS status, CASE WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'Order cancelled' ELSE 'Order accepted' END AS message, i.ticker AS symbol, o.side AS side, CAST(o.quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity, o.price AS price FROM orders o INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
